description: This file defines a controller class for managing the 'latest' module within the Opencart admin extension. It handles rendering the module editing page, saving configurations, adding new modules, and deleting modules, including permission checks and interfacing with models and views.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'latest' module in the Opencart admin panel, provides methods for module configuration, creation, deletion, and rendering of the module settings page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module configuration page, loads language and model resources, builds breadcrumbs, and prepares data for view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration, performs permission and validation checks, updates or creates module entries, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new 'latest' module with default title, after permission check, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module after permission check and returns JSON response.
